files_before.workshop.yaml:
name: dev
base: ubuntu@26.04
sdks:
  - name: node
    channel: 24
  - name: project-ompire-dev-setup
  - name: uv
  - name: openspec
  - name: try-zed-remote
  - name: try-open-design
  - name: llmvet
  - name: puppeteer-chrome
  - name: try-omp
    plugs:
      pi-auth-gateway:
        interface: tunnel
        endpoint: localhost:4000
  - name: system
    slots:
      pi-auth-gateway:
        interface: tunnel
        endpoint: localhost:4000
actions:
  test-backend: |
    cd <CWD>/daemon
    uv run pytest "$@"
  test-frontend: |
    cd <CWD>/frontend
    pnpm test "$@"
  lint-backend: |
    cd <CWD>/daemon
    uvx ruff check src tests "$@"
  lint-frontend: |
    cd <CWD>/frontend
    pnpm lint "$@"
  typecheck-backend: |
    cd <CWD>/daemon
    uv run --with mypy mypy src "$@"
  typecheck-frontend: |
    cd <CWD>/frontend
    pnpm exec tsc -b "$@"
